overall: No violation found. The Police Chief, not the Chair, removed a member of the public, and the Chair has discretion over public comment. The AG reminded the Board that removal should be a last resort.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleges the Board improperly removed a member of the public from the March 19 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Nonetheless, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law as it was the Police Chief and not the Chair who removed Mr. Longobardi from the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleges the Board did not allow a member of the public to speak during the March 19 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Law does not require that a public body allow public participation; rather, the Law gives the chair of the public body discretion to decide whether to permit public comment during a meeting
